title: SAGE: Similarity-Based Cleaning of Poisoned Training Data from Verified Examples
abstract: arXiv:2610.01788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As machine learning increasingly relies on public, untrusted data sources, data poisoning attacks, which inject malicious examples into training data to induce misclassification of a chosen target, pose a growing threat. Existing defenses either assume zero ground-truth information about which examples are poisoned, or they assume access to a large set of examples verified to be clean. Satisfying the latter assumption incurs significant cost since reliable verification can be very resource- or labor-intensive. This cost is particularly high for clean-label attacks, where poisoned examples are visually indistinguishable from clean data. Since requiring a large set of verified examples is impractical, we propose relying on a small set of verified examples including both clean and poisoned ones, i.e., each example verified either to be clean or poisoned through inspection by a forensic expert. translated_title: SAGE：基于相似性从已验证样本中清洗被投毒的训练数据
translated_abstract: 随着机器学习日益依赖公开的、不受信任的数据源，数据投毒攻击——即向训练数据中注入恶意样本以诱导模型对选定目标产生误分类——构成了日益严重的威胁。现有防御方法要么假设对哪些样本被投毒完全没有真实信息，要么假设可以获取大量已验证为干净的样本。满足后一种假设需要付出高昂代价，因为可靠的验证可能非常消耗资源或人力。对于干净标签攻击而言，这种代价尤为高昂，因为投毒样本在视觉上与干净数据难以区分。由于要求提供大量已验证样本并不现实，我们提出仅依赖一小组已验证样本，其中既包含干净样本也包含投毒样本，即每个样本都通过取证专家的检查被验证为干净或投毒。接下来的挑战是基于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SAGE方法，仅需一小组经专家验证（同时包含干净与投毒）的样本，利用相似性来检测并清洗被投毒的训练数据，从而避免了依赖大规模已验证干净数据集的高昂成本。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SAGE, which relies on a small set of expert-verified examples (including both clean and poisoned ones) and uses similarity-based methods to detect and remove poisoned training data, avoiding the prohibitive cost of requiring a large verified clean dataset.
